title: Cambridge IELTS 21 Test 4 Writing Task 2
prompt: Some people argue that primary schools focus too much on formal learning.
directions: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
scenario: Some people argue that primary schools focus too much on formal learning.
requirements: To what extent do you agree with this opinion?
How important do you think it is for children to play as well as learn in the primary school classroom?
Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
